content.title: Rory McIlroy Wins Another Masters as Daughter Poppy Cheers Him On
content.text: Key PointsRory McIlroy wins Masters again, celebrated by his daughter Poppy at Augusta National.McIlroy shares, “Watching my daughter grow up” brings him the most joy outside golf.Poppy actively participated in the Par 3 Contest, showing growing interest in golf. Another year, another green jacket. Golf legend Rory McIlroy may have taken the Masters by storm in a back-to-back win. But he’s not the only one in the family to steal the spotlight at Augusta National this year. His five-year-old daughter, Poppy (with wife Erica Stoll), is McIlroy’s biggest cheerleader, celebrating his 2026 win and “caddying” for the proud dad during the tournament’s family-friendly Par 3 Contest. In a congratulatory clip of his most recent win (posted on The Masters Instagram), the camera pans to the spectators. And who is clapping for McIlroy? None other than his doting daughter, Poppy. And then there was the iconic Green Jacket Ceremony. As McIlroy walked to the podium, the little girl stood with her mom (and the rest of the audience), continuing to clap for her dad. In his post-win speech, McIlroy gave a heartfelt thanks to his family, saying, “First and foremost, my wife and daughter Erica and Poppy, they have to put up with me at home and trust me, sometimes that’s a tough thing to do.” He added, “But they have been my biggest supporters, and this has definitely turned into Poppy’s favorite week of the year. I don’t know if it’s the Par 3 tournament or the all-you-can-eat ice cream in the players’ services building.” And like any other five-year-old, Poppy shook her head and covered her face at the ‘dad’ joke.’ Priceless! When asked, in a recent interview with CBS, what has brought him the most joy away from the game, McIlroy said, “I’d say watching my daughter grow up. I think Poppy is, um, she’s a mini Erica.” In other words, she’s just like mom. McIlroy met his wife in 2012 at the Ryder Cup. The pair married in 2017 and became parents to their only child, Poppy, in 2020. Almost six years ago, the then-new dad shared a precious black-and-white pic of his little girl’s teeny-tiny hand, announcing her birth on Instagram. McIlroy captioned the photo, “Poppy Kennedy McIlroy, born August 31st, 12:15 p.m. She is the absolute love of our lives. Mother and baby are doing great.” How does McIlroy describe his daughter now? He continued, in the recent interview, “She is the most unbelievably polite, respectful, and well-behaved little girl.” Is there another pro player in this family’s future? It seems like golf is in Poppy’s genes. The two-time Masters winner added, “And I really loved that she started to get into the game a lot more. And it all stemmed from the putt last year at the par three. So she made sure that I brought her putter up this year so that she could hit the putt with her putter and not mine…So that’s been amazing,” Of course, this isn’t exactly Poppy’s first go at the Master’s Par 3 Contest. Back in 2023, the doting dad posted a cute clip of his daughter at the event, writing on Instagram, “Always one of the best days of the year.” It looks like bringing her own putter helped her chances this year. In the 2026 contest, Poppy got a 25-footer (downhill) with dad by her side. Spending time together on the green isn’t the only wish the golfer has for his daughter. He explained, “And just to see her grow up to have her travel the world to see different places, you know, to give her a life that, you know, I could only dream about when I was that age.” Aww! About the authorErica Loop is a seasoned freelance writer and educator with an M.S. in Child Development from the University of Pittsburgh. Along with over a decade of experience creating parenting, education, commerce, and lifestyle content, she’s also taught children’s programs at Pittsburgh’s Carnegie Museum of Art and for other local organizations.
